head: TASK12
profile_source: isolated lua_calls perf record (5M inc() calls), perf annotate
note: Profile shares from tools/perf/current-profile-index.json (2026-09-02 fresh). The old analysis (head e4e384b) predates T17 (lazy activeErrorHandlerDepth) — stale. This re-audit is against HEAD 4b7d9ee + Task 12 changes.

classification.description: Re-audited classification of every operation in pushBytecodeExecFrame for the common non-vararg Lua-to-Lua case (args_on_stack=true, is_vahid=false, no overflow). Source: vm.zig HEAD 4b7d9ee + Task 12 cold-outlining.

operations.note: Diagnostic counter, gated by stats.enabled (default-off). Branch per-activation, predicted not-taken.

Caller knows whether args are on bc_stack. Pointer arithmetic: 2 intFromPtr + shift + 2 adds + compare. ~5% of function. NOT parameterized — the check is a safety mechanism for stale-slice cases (bc_stack realloc between rargs creation and push). Kept as-is.
T12: outlined to noinline prepareHostArgs. Cold: runBytecodeInternal, builtin pcall, metamethods, debug hooks, coroutine resume.
T12: deleted. Empty range (@max(nparams,nparams)==nparams). VAHID requires nextra>0 i.e. nargs>nparams, so missing params are impossible.
T12: outlined to noinline prepareVahidShift. Cold: vararg functions without vararg table AND with extra args.
Short-circuits common case (bc_stack.len small). activeErrorHandlerDepth() only called when bc_stack.len > 1M (already lazy via T17).
T12: outlined to noinline raiseFrameOverflow. Cold: realloc to PHYSICAL_LIMIT + fail.
No-op common case (stack already big enough).
Loop empty when nactual >= nparams (common case).
Every field initialized exactly once. CallFrame <= 104B comptime assert preserved.

task12_changes.impact: Code clarity; no hot-path perf (cold is_vahid branch)

task12_changes.change: Outlined host-args path to noinline prepareHostArgs
task12_changes.impact: Reduces register pressure in hot path — callee-saved registers no longer needed for host-args copy

task12_changes.change: Outlined VAHID buildhiddenargs to noinline prepareVahidShift
task12_changes.impact: Reduces register pressure — VAHID shift loops no longer inline

task12_changes.change: Outlined overflow body to noinline raiseFrameOverflow
task12_changes.impact: Keeps allocator vtable calls + bc_boxed reload out of hot path register pressure

rejected_candidates.candidate: Cached total field in FrameStack for single-load len()
rejected_candidates.why: Caused +6-7% layout regression on field_access (Thread field displacement — STATUS P16.9 layout caveat). Reverted.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Branched len() (inline_count < CAP ? inline_count : CAP + heap.len)
rejected_candidates.why: Caused binary-layout regressions on field_access (+7.3%) and coroutine_yield (+5.8%) from codegen shift. Reverted.

The check is a safety mechanism for stale-slice cases (bc_stack realloc between rargs creation and push). Parameterizing risks use-after-free if a caller passes true when args are stale. Not worth the risk for ~0.6% total workload gain.
